job.title: Leading Hand / Foreman
job.description:
We’re working with a leading civil contractor who is looking to add an experienced Leading Hand / Foreman to their team on the Sunshine Coast.

The business has a strong pipeline of civil infrastructure work, including TMR projects, and is looking for someone who can take ownership on site and help drive projects through to completion.

The Role
  • Lead crews across civil and infrastructure projects
  • Work across major road and TMR projects
  • Coordinate subcontractors, plant and labour
  • Ensure works are delivered safely, efficiently and to program
  • Work closely with the Project Manager and wider site team
  • Maintain high standards across quality and site compliance
About You
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in civil construction
  • Previous experience as a Leading Hand or Foreman
  • Strong background in civil infrastructure and/or TMR projects
  • Confident leading crews and coordinating site activities
  • Strong understanding of safety, quality and project delivery
  • Good communication and leadership skills
  • Based on or willing to work on the Sunshine Coast
What's on Offer
  • Sunshine Coast based projects
  • Strong pipeline of civil infrastructure work
  • Opportunity to work on major TMR projects
  • Competitive salary package
  • Long-term opportunity with a reputable contractor
If you’re an experienced Leading Hand or Foreman and looking for your next opportunity on the Sunshine Coast, get in touch with Jimmy Stewart on 0423 611 276 or jstewart@designandbuild.com.au for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Maintenance Fitter
job.description:
Maintenance Fitter – Smithfield
$50–$55/hr + Overtime | Day Shift | Permanent Position 

Join a national manufacturing business and work in a highly automated production environment where your mechanical skills will be valued and there is plenty of opportunity to earn additional income through overtime.

As a Maintenance Fitter, you will be responsible for keeping the manufacturing operation running smoothly and efficiently.

  • As a Maintenance Fitter you'll carry out preventative and breakdown maintenance across automated production equipment
  • This Maintenance Fitter will carry out mechanical fault finding and repairs
  • The Maintenance Fitter will have Hydraulic & Pneumatic experience 
  • The Maintenance Fitter will be servicing and maintaining plant, machinery and production equipment
  • As the Maintenance Fitter you'll be responding to breakdowns and minimising production downtime
  • This Maintenance Fitter will identify potential equipment issues before they become major problems
  • The Maintenance Fitter will support with continuous improvement and reliability initiatives
  • This Maintenance Fitter will work closely with production and maintenance teams
You'll ideally have:
  • Trade qualifications as a Maintenance Fitter / Fitter & Turner
  • Previous experience in manufacturing environments
  • Strong mechanical fault-finding and troubleshooting skills
  • Experience working with automated machinery
  • A proactive approach to preventative maintenance
  • The ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • A strong commitment to workplace safety
What's In It For You?
  • $50–$55 per hour, depending on experience
  • Day shift
  • Full-time permanent employment
  • Overtime available – excellent earning potential
  • Work for a national and well-established manufacturing business
  • Highly automated and modern manufacturing environment
  • Long-term stability and career opportunities
  • Join a supportive and professional maintenance team
Apply Now If you're a qualified Maintenance Fitter looking for a permanent day-shift role, strong hourly rates and plenty of overtime opportunities, apply now or contact us for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Site Manager - Contract | Fit out
job.description:
Design and Build are currently seeking a Site Manager for a minimum 3 month month contract to join a national contractor for a $5 million medical project located south of the river in Perth.  

Contract due to start 1st week of October, opportunity  to extend with further projects in the pipeline. Opportunity to move onto a second project upon completion running for another 3 months. 

Key Responsibilities:
  • Manage and coordinate all on-site activities for commercial fit-out projects up to $4M
  • Supervise subcontractors and trades to ensure programme milestones are achieved
  • Drive site safety and ensure full WHS compliance
  • Maintain high-quality finishes in fast-paced fit-out programmes
  • Manage site documentation, RFIs, and defect resolution via Procore
  • Conduct site meetings and provide regular progress updates to the Project Manager
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope
Requirements:
  • Proven experience as a Site Manager delivering commercial office fit-out projects
  • Experience managing projects valued up to $4M
  • Strong working knowledge and hands-on experience using Procore (essential)
  • Experience working within live environments
  • Strong leadership and subcontractor management skills
  • Excellent understanding of programme management and sequencing in fit-out
  • Trade background or relevant construction qualification preferred

To apply for this position, hit 'APPLY NOW' or please send an updated CV to bethany@designandbuild.com.au. For more information please call Jamie Harney at Design & Build on 0478 041 269

job.title: Senior Site Manager - Class 2 high-rise Apartments
job.description:
Site Manager – $60M Class 2 High-Rise Residential

As a Site Manager, you will take ownership of the successful delivery of a $60M Class 2 high-rise residential apartment project in Sydney, working closely with the Project Manager and wider project team to deliver a high-quality project safely, on time and within budget.
The Role As Site Manager, you will be responsible for the overall day-to-day management and delivery of the project, leading site operations and coordinating subcontractors, consultants and site teams to ensure project milestones, quality, safety and commercial targets are achieved.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Taking overall responsibility for day-to-day site operations and project delivery
  • Leading and managing subcontractors, trades, labour and site-based teams
  • Managing the construction program, sequencing, site logistics and project milestones
  • Driving project outcomes across cost, quality, safety and program
  • Coordinating consultants, subcontractors, suppliers and internal project stakeholders
  • Managing site inductions, WHS requirements, risk management and site compliance
  • Overseeing construction from structure through to fit-out, finishing and defects
  • Ensuring works are delivered in accordance with plans, specifications and quality standards
  • Identifying and resolving construction issues and implementing effective solutions
  • Maintaining strong relationships with subcontractors, consultants and project stakeholders
  • Providing leadership, direction and support to the wider site team
  • Utilising site management systems including Hamertech and Procore
About You:
  • 4+ years’ experience as a Site Manager within the construction industry
  • Strong experience delivering Class 2 high-rise or multi-storey residential apartment projects
  • Proven experience managing projects from structure through to completion and handover
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, buildability and complex site logistics
  • Experience managing subcontractors, consultants and large site teams
  • Strong knowledge of WHS, quality assurance and project compliance
  • Excellent leadership, communication and problem-solving skills
  • Construction-related qualification or trade background
  • A strong track record of delivering projects safely, on time and to a high standard
What’s On Offer / Salary Package
  • Salary: Up to $250k Plus Super DOE
  • Opportunity to take ownership of projects valued up to $60M Class 2 residential development
  • Strong pipeline of future projects, primarily based around the same location
  • Long-term opportunity with an established Australian builder delivering high-quality residential developments across Sydney
For a confidential discussion, please contact Emily Collins at Design & Build Recruitment on 02 9376 8200 or click Apply.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Project Manager to join a highly regarded mid-tier civil contractor delivering major infrastructure projects across Brisbane and the Sunshine Coast.

With a strong pipeline of work and projects valued up to $60 million, this is an opportunity to join a business with an outstanding reputation for delivering quality infrastructure while, importantly, retaining and developing its people.

This is a genuine leadership opportunity for a Project Manager who enjoys being close to the delivery of projects, working collaboratively with clients and stakeholders, and having the autonomy to make decisions and drive outcomes.

The Role As Project Manager, you will take overall responsibility for the successful delivery of major civil infrastructure projects, managing the project from planning and mobilisation through to completion.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Overall leadership and management of projects valued up to $60M
  • Managing project budgets, commercial performance, programme and resources
  • Leading Project Engineers, Site Engineers, Supervisors and site-based teams
  • Managing subcontractors, suppliers, consultants and key stakeholders
  • Developing and maintaining project programmes and delivery strategies
  • Managing client relationships and ensuring contractual obligations are met
  • Identifying and managing commercial, construction and project risks
  • Driving safety, quality and environmental outcomes across the project
  • Managing variations, progress claims, forecasting and project reporting
  • Ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to the required quality standards
You will be an experienced Civil Project Manager OR SPE with a strong background delivering infrastructure projects in Queensland.

Ideally, you will have:
  • Proven experience managing civil infrastructure projects, ideally $20M–$60M+
  • Strong experience working on TMR and/or Local Government projects
  • A recognised Civil Engineering qualification
  • RPEQ qualification
  • Strong commercial and contractual understanding
  • Proven leadership capability with project delivery teams
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • A strong understanding of Queensland civil construction practices, standards and specifications
  • A track record of delivering projects safely, commercially and successfully
The Company This is a high-performing mid-tier contractor with a strong reputation throughout Queensland.

Unlike many larger organisations, they offer their Project Managers genuine autonomy, direct access to senior leadership and the opportunity to have a meaningful influence on project outcomes.

The business has built its reputation through quality project delivery, strong client relationships and, importantly, retaining good people.

You'll be joining an organisation where high performance is recognised, people are trusted to do their jobs and long-term career development is encouraged.

What's on Offer
  • $220,000 – $240,000 + Super
  • Company vehicle
  • Civil infrastructure projects up to $60M
  • Brisbane & Sunshine Coast project opportunities
  • Strong pipeline of upcoming work
  • High level of autonomy and ownership
  • Excellent senior leadership team
  • Stable, established mid-tier contractor
  • Strong reputation for retaining its people
  • Genuine long-term career opportunity
If you're an experienced Project Manager or SPE looking for the next step, apply now or reach out to Jimmy Stewart on 0423 611 276 or jstewart@designandbuild.com.au

job.title: Lead Power Systems Engineer
job.description:
Position: Lead Power Systems Engineer
Location: Adelaide, SA
Salary: Up to $185,000 base + super

Design & Build is working with an established Australian EPC contractor growing its engineering team across major transmission, substation and renewable energy projects.

We’re looking for a Lead Power Systems Engineer with strong hands-on modelling and analysis experience who can make an immediate technical impact within the team.

Why Join?
  • Strong pipeline of transmission and substation projects
  • Work within an established multidisciplinary engineering team
  • Exposure from studies and detailed design through to construction
  • Progression into leadership roles
The Role

This is broader than a traditional grid connection role. You’ll take ownership of the power systems studies and modelling required to support HV substation design, working closely with primary, secondary and protection engineers throughout detailed design and delivery.

What You'll Do
  • Independently perform power systems studies and detailed modelling
  • Deliver network analysis required for HV substation design
  • Perform load flow, short circuit and network stability analysis
  • Develop and validate models for transformers, transmission lines, generators and inverter-based resources
  • Assess designs against NER, AEMO and NSP requirements
  • Interpret study results and provide practical recommendations to the design team
  • Support projects through detailed design and commissioning
  • Review technical work and mentor junior engineers
What We're Looking For
  • 5+ years’ experience in power systems engineering
  • Strong hands-on modelling and analysis capability
  • Experience delivering studies in support of HV substation design
  • Strong DIgSILENT PowerFactory experience
  • PSCAD experience highly regarded
  • Australian transmission, substation or NSP project experience
  • Strong understanding of Australian network standards and requirements
Apply now or contact Jasmine Wiklander on 0405 437 667 for a confidential discussion.

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

job.description:

You'll take responsibility for the day-to-day running of site, working closely with the Project Manager, subcontractors, consultants and client to ensure the project is delivered safely, to a high standard and on programme.
You'll be responsible for:
  • Managing and coordinating subcontractors and trades
  • Driving programme and construction sequencing
  • Maintaining quality and OH&S standards
  • Coordinating consultants and resolving site issues
  • Reading and interpreting construction drawings
  • Managing site documentation and reporting

This isn't a role for someone who simply wants to tick boxes. We're looking for a technically strong Supervisor who can take ownership, make decisions, push subcontractors when required and keep a project moving.

What's on offer?
A long-term opportunity with an established commercial builder, a substantial project to get your teeth into and the potential to move directly onto another stage/project once completed.

Interested? Apply now or reach out for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Estimating Manager
job.description:
About the Company
A well-established residential building business based in Hamilton, Brisbane, is looking for an experienced Estimating Manager to take ownership of its estimating program.

Estimating sits at the centre of the business, with projects priced from in-house designs, quantity take-offs, supplier and trade rates. The business operates through a fully integrated Databuild and Onsite Companion workflow system.

With the current Estimating Manager moving on, this is an opportunity for an experienced estimator to step into a key position, take ownership of the estimating function and build on the systems already in place.

About the Role
As the Estimating Manager, you will take ownership of the estimating program while remaining hands-on with the day-to-day estimating function.
You will prepare take-offs, budgets and estimates, manage supplier and trade pricing, identify cost-saving opportunities and lead and mentor the estimating team.

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, you will work closely with the construction, operations and product development teams to ensure projects are accurately priced, cost-effective and aligned with the company's objectives.
This is a key role for someone who is committed, reliable and enthusiastic, with a strong focus on accuracy, efficiency, profitability and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities
  • Operate and maintain the integrated Databuild system, including cost codes, catalogues and pricing databases.
  • Maintain the flow of data between Databuild and Onsite Companion.
  • Prepare and review accurate quantity take-offs, bills of quantities and Job Analysis Reports.
  • Conduct technical plan reviews at both Preliminary Plans and Working Drawings stages.
  • Prepare detailed cost estimates for customer proposals, factoring in general and special conditions.
  • Ensure sales estimates meet required budgets and deadlines.
  • Develop scopes of works for external stakeholders.
  • Review supplier and subcontractor quotations and negotiate pricing to identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Prepare project budgets for management approval and monitor actual costs against budget.
  • Report on project progress, costs and profitability to management.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Ensure subcontractor licences and insurances are current and accurately recorded in Onsite Companion.
  • Lead, mentor and support the estimating team.
  • Assist with internal projects and business initiatives as required.
About You To be successful in this role, you will have:
  • 5+ years' experience in construction estimating, ideally within residential building.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with Databuild, including operation, administration and maintaining pricing databases and cost codes.
  • Strong knowledge of cost estimation, bills of quantities and material take-offs.
  • Experience conducting technical plan reviews at Preliminary Plans and Working Drawings stages.
  • Experience preparing detailed budgets and analysing supplier and subcontractor quotations.
  • Strong understanding of subcontractor compliance, including licensing and insurance requirements.
  • Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • A highly analytical, organised and detail-oriented approach.
  • The ability to identify cost savings without compromising quality.
  • A proactive and results-driven approach, with a focus on process improvement.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities.
  • Relevant qualifications in construction management, quantity surveying or estimating, or equivalent industry experience.
Our Systems Hands-on Databuild experience is essential. The successful candidate will be trained on the other systems where required.
  • Databuild – Construction estimating, job costing and accounting.
  • Onsite Companion – Site and project management, linked with Databuild.
  • Therefore – Document management and invoice approval workflow.
The Opportunity This is an opportunity to step into a key position within a growing residential building business and have genuine ownership over the estimating function.

You will have the opportunity to lead an established estimating team, work directly with the Managing Director and contribute to improving systems, processes and profitability across the business.

If you are an experienced residential estimator with strong Databuild experience and are ready to take the next step into an Estimating Manager position, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now with your CV, or contact us for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Senior Project Manager
job.description:
Senior Project Manager
A well-established, Tier 2 construction and remedial contractor is experiencing strong, consistent growth across Sydney and seeking a Senior Project Manager to join their business. With around 40 staff and a supportive, down-to-earth culture, the company is known for work-life balance, professional integrity, and long-term client relationships.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and deliver remedial construction projects to the value of $12M from planning through to completion.
  • Read and interpret architectural and structural drawings, assess buildability and sequence remedial works accordingly.
  • Procure materials and subcontractors (balconies, glazing, waterproofing, tiling, paving, concrete repairs, etc).
  • Schedule, coordinate and supervise all trades and subcontractors to meet project milestones.
  • Foresee and plan works ahead by 2–3 weeks, anticipating ordering, resource allocation and site requirements.
  • Maintain quality, safety and compliance in accordance with company standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide clear reporting and communication to senior management, stakeholders and clients.
  • Manage a small project team — ensuring productivity, workmanship standards and timely delivery.
About You / Requirements
  • Proven experience as a Project Manager in construction (remedial experience ideal but not essential).
  • Strong technical understanding of building systems, remedial solutions, waterproofing, and structural works.
  • Ability to read and interpret complex drawings and translate them into practical delivery.
  • Excellent planning, organisational, and sequencing capability.
  • Strong people skills with the ability to influence, lead, and manage stakeholders.
  • Solid financial acumen for budgeting and cost control.
  • Safety-driven mindset, with experience managing live environments.
  • Confident communicator with strong written reporting skills.
What’s On Offer / Salary Package
  • Salary Package up to $240k Plus Super DOE
  • Opportunity to lead a significant remedial project — high-profile high-rise remedial works in Sydney
  • Stable Monday–Friday schedule; No Saturday's required
  • Job security and opportunity for career growth
For any questions relating to this role or other opportunities with D&B and our clients please contact Emily Collins on 0468927246 or click apply. Your application will be treated as strictly confidential.

job.title: HSE Advisor - FIFO - 2:1
job.description:
Our client is a well-established contractor with a strong presence across the WA resources and civil construction sector. With ongoing work and a long-term project secured, they are looking to add an experienced HSE Advisor to the existing site team.

This is a FIFO position working on a 2:1 roster, supporting a long-term civil construction project. The initial contract will be 4 - 6 months, with the potential for extension and ongoing work for the right person.

You will be working closely with the Site Management team, Supervisors, subcontractors and wider workforce, providing hands-on HSE support across the project and ensuring a high standard of safety, compliance and risk management is maintained.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced HSE Advisor who enjoys being hands-on, working closely with site teams and having a genuine impact on safety performance.

About You:
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience working on Rio Tinto sites
  • Fully compliant with current Rio Tinto training requirements
  • Previous HSE Advisor experience within civil construction
  • Strong knowledge of WHS legislation, risk management and safety systems
  • Hands-on approach and comfortable working in a site-based environment
  • Confident communicating with workers, supervisors, subcontractors and management
  • Strong understanding of JHAs, SWMS, risk assessments and incident management
  • Able to work autonomously while also being part of a wider site team
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills
  • Current Australian Driver’s Licence
  • Available to work a 2:1 FIFO roster
  • Looking for a long-term opportunity with a reputable contractor
Key Responsibilities:
  • Providing day-to-day HSE support across civil construction activities
  • Working closely with Site Management and Supervisors to ensure safe delivery of works
  • Conducting regular site inspections, audits and safety observations
  • Supporting the development and review of JHAs, SWMS and risk assessments
  • Identifying hazards and working with site teams to implement effective controls
  • Supporting incident reporting, investigations and corrective actions through to close-out
  • Conducting and supporting pre-starts, toolbox meetings and safety communications
  • Monitoring compliance with HSE systems, procedures and client requirements
  • Maintaining HSE documentation, records and reporting
  • Supporting site inductions and onboarding requirements
  • Providing practical safety advice, coaching and guidance to workers and supervisors
  • Promoting a positive and proactive safety culture across the project
  • Ensuring project activities are completed in line with required HSE standards and procedures
You will be joining an established project team with experienced leadership around you, working on a long-term civil construction project with the potential for ongoing work beyond the initial contract.
A competitive hourly rate will be negotiated based on your experience and suitability for the role.

If you're an experienced HSE Advisor with strong Rio Tinto experience and are looking for your next FIFO opportunity, click APPLY NOW and register your details.

Alternatively, contact Aaron Walsh via email at awalsh@designandbuild.com.au or on 0412 786 746 for more information.

job.title: Mechanical Draftsman
job.description:
Mechanical Draftsman
Location: Dandenong South, VIC
Salary: $100,000 - $120,000 + Super + Benefits

Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time
Work Arrangement: On-site
 
About the Company
Our client is a well-established Tier 2 Mechanical & Electrical (MEP) Contractor delivering mechanical services across a range of commercial, industrial, infrastructure and technically complex projects throughout Melbourne.
With a strong reputation for quality project delivery, technical capability and long-term client relationships, the business is continuing to grow and is looking to add an experienced Mechanical Draftsman to its project delivery team.
About the Role
This is an excellent opportunity for a Mechanical Draftsman to join a growing MEP contractor and work closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Site Teams and other trades to produce accurate and constructible mechanical drawings.
You will be involved throughout the project lifecycle, from initial design development and coordination through to construction documentation and as-built drawings.
Key Responsibilities
  • Produce detailed mechanical shop drawings, fabrication drawings and construction documentation
  • Develop and modify drawings in line with project requirements and engineering specifications
  • Work closely with Project Managers, Mechanical Engineers and Site Teams to ensure drawings are practical and constructible
  • Coordinate mechanical services with electrical, hydraulic, structural and architectural disciplines
  • Review designs and identify potential clashes, discrepancies or constructability issues
  • Attend project and coordination meetings where required
  • Incorporate site changes and provide accurate as-built documentation
  • Assist with material take-offs and project documentation where required
  • Ensure drawings are produced accurately and in accordance with relevant Australian Standards and project specifications
  • Manage multiple drawing packages and project deadlines simultaneously
  • Liaise with subcontractors, suppliers and other project stakeholders as required
About You
We are looking for a technically capable Mechanical Draftsman who understands the realities of delivering mechanical services in a construction environment.
You will ideally have:
  • Previous experience as a Mechanical Draftsman within the construction or MEP services industry
  • Experience producing mechanical services drawings for commercial, industrial, infrastructure or similar projects
  • Strong knowledge of AutoCAD
  • Experience with Revit / BIM would be highly regarded
  • Understanding of mechanical services including HVAC, ductwork, pipework and associated equipment
  • Strong understanding of construction documentation and coordination
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications and architectural documentation
  • Strong attention to detail and a practical approach to problem solving
  • Ability to work collaboratively with project and site teams
  • Excellent organisation and time-management skills
  • Relevant Australian construction/MEP drafting experience
What's On Offer
  • $100,000 - $120,000 + Super, depending on experience
  • Full-time, on-site position based in Dandenong South
  • Opportunity to join a growing Tier 2 MEP contractor
  • Exposure to a diverse range of technically complex projects ranging from Residential Towers to Data Centre
  • Close involvement with experienced Project Managers, Engineers and Site Teams
  • Opportunity for long-term career development within the business and progress to Drafting Manager
  • Strong long-term pipeline of projects
  • A practical, collaborative and project-focused working environment
Apply Now
If you're an experienced Mechanical Draftsman looking to join a reputable MEP contractor and play a key role in the delivery of major construction projects, we'd like to hear from you.
Apply now with your CV for a confidential discussion. Alternatively, please contact Connor Gwilliam.

job.title: Maintenance & Operations Manager
job.description:
Position: Maintenance & Operations Manager
Location: Regional NSW
Roster: Initially 5/2, transitioning to 14/7 on site
Salary: $180k to $220k base + super, + 25% site uplift

Design & Build has partnered with a major EPC contractor delivering the complete electrical and mechanical scope on one of Australia’s largest power generation projects, and we are recruiting a Maintenance & Operations Manager to establish the maintenance function for a new power plant from the ground up.

Why Join?
  • Permanent position with a major global EPC contractor
  • Long term project duration of 2+ years, with a pipeline of further projects to follow
  • Build the maintenance function for a new power plant from the ground up
  • Flagship power generation project 
Key Responsibilities

Employer: A global leader in automated logistics and materials handling systems
Location: Western Sydney (on-site during project phases)
Project: Large-scale automated materials handling systems as part of a major infrastructure development

About the Role Our client, a global leader in automated logistics and materials handling systems, is looking for a Controls/PLC Engineer to join the team delivering critical automation systems for a major infrastructure project in Western Sydney. This is a rare opportunity to work on one of the region's most significant infrastructure builds, with long-term career runway as the project moves from installation through commissioning and into live operations.

You'll be responsible for the design, programming, testing, and commissioning of PLC-based control systems that drive automated baggage handling — critical, high-availability systems where reliability and safety are non-negotiable.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and commission PLC and SCADA control systems for large-scale automated materials handling equipment
  • Program and configure using Siemens PLC platforms (S7, TIA Portal, WinCC or equivalent)

  • Support continuous improvement and reliability initiatives as the system transitions into live operation
About You
  • Degree qualified in Electrical, Electronic, Mechatronic, or Controls Engineering (or equivalent trade + experience pathway)
  • Proven hands-on experience with Siemens PLC programming (S7-300/400/1500, TIA Portal) — essential
  • Experience with SCADA/HMI systems (WinCC or similar)
  • Background in materials handling, conveyor systems, or large-scale automated logistics systems highly regarded
  • Comfortable working on a live, high-profile infrastructure project with strict safety and quality standards
  • Strong fault-finding and commissioning experience — able to work through complex control system issues under pressure
  • Excellent communication skills, able to liaise across engineering, project management, and client stakeholders
Why Apply

  • Work with a global benchmark name in automated logistics and materials handling
  • Long-term career pathway as the project moves from delivery into ongoing operations and support

  • Coordinate meetings, minutes and follow-up actions
  • Assist with timesheets, labour records and resource tracking
  • Liaise with subcontractors, suppliers, clients and internal stakeholders
  • Ensure project documentation is accurate, current and compliant

About You:

We’re looking for someone who is organised, proactive and confident working in a fast-paced construction environment.
You will ideally have:
  • Previous experience in Project Administration, Site Administration or Project Coordination
  • Experience within the construction, engineering, civil or infrastructure sectors
  • Strong administration and organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Experience dealing with subcontractors, suppliers and project teams

  • Experience with construction/project management systems such as Aconex, Procore, Jobpac or similar would be advantageous
  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to liaise with stakeholders at all levels
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work to deadlines
  • A proactive attitude and willingness to support the wider project team

job.description:

This is a permanent, long-term opportunity for an experienced Utilities Supervisor or Senior Supervisor looking for strong project security, career development and the opportunity to play a key role in major utilities programs.
  
The Role
  
You’ll supervise predominantly capital upgrades across major utilities projects in Brisbane.
  
Key responsibilities include:

  • Supervising utilities maintenance, upgrades and construction works
  • Managing daily site activities, labour, plant, resources and subcontractors
  • Planning and coordinating works to achieve safety, productivity and program targets
  • Leading pre-starts, toolbox talks and daily site coordination
  • Maintaining strong health, safety, environmental and quality standards.
  • Ensuring SWMS, risk controls and corrective actions are implemented.
  • Reporting incidents, near misses and non-conformances and assisting with investigations.

About You
  
You’ll ideally have:
  • 5+ years’ experience in a Supervisory role within construction or water industry
  • QBCC Builder Open licence or hold qualifications and experience aligned with Builder Open Licence requirements
  • Relevant trade qualification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proven experience across water, utilities, civil infrastructure or capital works.
  • Ability to lead direct labour teams and subcontractors.
  • Strong leadership, communication and people management skills.
  • Solid understanding of construction methods, site delivery, safety, quality and risk management.
  • A genuine commitment to maintaining a strong safety culture.
  
What’s On Offer
  • Permanent, long-term employment with a Tier 1 contractor.
  • Strong pipeline of major infrastructure and utilities work.
  • Greater Brisbane-based projects.
  • Competitive salary package.
  • Genuine career progression, training, mentoring and leadership support.
  • Health and wellbeing initiatives, employee discounts and additional benefits.
  • A strong, down-to-earth culture focused on teamwork, innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Opportunity to work on projects delivering meaningful outcomes for local communities.

job.title: Estimator - Cabinetry & Custom Joinery
job.description:

job.title: Pre Construction Manager
job.description:
Pre-Construction Manager
Melbourne, VIC | Permanent Full-Time
 
The Opportunity
Design & Build Recruitment is partnering with a well-established and growing electrical services contractor to appoint an experienced Pre-Construction Manager.
This is a key leadership position sitting at the intersection of Estimating, Design and Operations, taking ownership of projects from early contractor involvement and tender stage through to procurement, delivery planning and operational handover.
 
The role will suit an experienced Project Manager, Senior Estimator, Pre-Construction Manager or Engineer who understands the realities of delivering complex construction projects and enjoys influencing outcomes before construction begins.
With a strong pipeline of major projects and continued business growth, this position offers the opportunity to establish and develop a dedicated pre-construction function, with the expectation that the successful candidate will eventually lead a team.
 
The Role
As Pre-Construction Manager, you will play a critical role in ensuring projects transition effectively from concept and tender through to delivery.
Working closely with senior leadership, estimators, designers and project delivery teams, you will lead ECI and bid opportunities, review major project estimates, identify commercial and technical risks, and develop operational budgets and production metrics ahead of project commencement.
You will remain involved through early design and procurement, ensuring a structured and commercially robust handover into operations.
 
Key Responsibilities
Tender & Estimating
  • Lead and coordinate ECI and major bid opportunities alongside estimating and design teams.
  • Review significant project estimates through to final negotiation stages.
  • Provide input into buildability, constructability and design reviews.
  • Support labour rate build-ups, schedules of rates and standardised estimating information.
  • Provide technical and commercial advice around client budgets, design and project strategy.
  • Support business development activity and major tender opportunities.
Pre-Construction & Project Planning
  • Translate awarded project estimates into operational budgets and production metrics.
  • Undertake detailed reviews of project scope, design and documentation ahead of delivery.
  • Establish and manage project Risk & Opportunity registers.
  • Identify value engineering and design efficiency opportunities.
  • Coordinate early procurement of long-lead and engineered equipment.
  • Lead formal project handovers from pre-construction into operational delivery teams.
  • Coordinate early design engagement with clients and internal design teams.
Project Delivery Support
  • Maintain involvement through early design and procurement stages.
  • Support project teams during the transition into construction.
  • Drive lessons learned and continuous improvement across project delivery.
Leadership & Process Improvement
  • Improve pre-construction processes, systems, templates and reporting.
  • Maintain accurate records across estimates, budgets and handover documentation.
  • Provide reporting on pipeline opportunities, project handovers and key lessons learned.
  • Play a key role in developing the future pre-construction function, with the opportunity to build and lead a team.
About You
We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of the construction lifecycle and the ability to bridge the gap between winning work and successfully delivering it.
You may currently be working as a:
  • Pre-Construction Manager
  • Senior Project Manager
  • Project Manager with strong estimating experience
  • Senior Estimator looking to move closer to project strategy and delivery
  • Electrical or Building Services Engineer with significant commercial project experience
Ideally, you will bring:
  • Experience in project management and/or engineering combined with estimating experience within the construction industry.
  • A strong understanding of buildability, constructability and design review.
  • Experience across the full project lifecycle, from ECI and tender through to design, procurement and project handover.
  • The ability to review complex scopes and identify commercial, technical and delivery risks.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work across estimating, design, operations and client teams.
  • Experience identifying value engineering and design efficiency opportunities.
  • Excellent analytical, commercial and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience within electrical services, building services, industrial construction, infrastructure or mission-critical/data centre environments will be highly regarded.
 
What's On Offer?
This is a genuine opportunity to take ownership of a critical function within a growing contractor.
You will have:
  • A highly influential role across major projects.
  • Package: $180,000 - $220,000 + super + vehicle/car allowance (DOE)
  • Exposure to projects from tender through to delivery.
  • The opportunity to shape and improve pre-construction processes.
  • Close collaboration with senior leadership.
  • A clear pathway into building and leading a dedicated pre-construction team.
  • A strong pipeline of complex electrical and infrastructure projects.
  • A permanent, long-term career opportunity with a growing Melbourne-based contractor.
Apply
If you are an experienced construction professional looking to move into a strategic pre-construction leadership role, we'd like to hear from you.
For a confidential discussion, please contact Connor Gwilliam at Design & Build Recruitment, or apply directly via the link below.
All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Project Manager

Design & Build Recruitment is searching for a quality Project Manager, who has the desire to work for a reputable and national Tier 3 full D&C commercial construction company. With a reputation for delivering excellence, our focus on projects ranging from $15M to $40M.

The Role
We are seeking an experienced and driven Project Manager. You will be involved in new build projects in the most part. However, time to time, you could be required to assist on Fitout projects in between New Build projects. The bonus is that you will have quality job security. You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end delivery of one or multiple projects depending on size and scope.

The ideal applicant will either be an established Project Manager who has experience delivering new build projects, or a Project Engineer from the Teir 1 space looking for an opportunity to work as a Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities
  • Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of projects valued between $15M and $40M.
  • Manage project timelines, budgets, and resources to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, and subcontractors to achieve project goals.
  • Lead and mentor project teams, fostering a positive and productive work environment.
  • Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards throughout project lifecycles.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks to maintain project integrity.
About You
To be successful in this role, you will have:
  • Proven experience managing new build construction projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver projects in the $15M-$40M range.
  • Strong knowledge of construction processes, contracts, and project management methodologies.
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Benefits

  • Competitive remuneration package and career progression opportunities.

job.title: Commissioning Technician
job.description:
Industrial Electrician – Testing & Commissioning
Location: Eastern Creek, NSW
Employment Type: Full Time | Permanent
Salary: $60–$65 per hour (depending on experience)

We are seeking an experienced Industrial Electrician to join our growing team based in Eastern Creek.

This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated electrician with strong commissioning and testing experience to work on fuel system installations and associated control systems across a range of  industrial sites throughout Sydney.

If you enjoy solving technical challenges, working with modern automation systems, and being part of a supportive team delivering high-quality projects, we'd love to hear from you.

As an Industrial Electrician, you will be responsible for the testing, commissioning and ongoing support of electrical systems associated with fuel infrastructure projects.
Key Responsibilities
  • As an Electrician you will carry out testing and commissioning electrical systems.
  • This Electrician will assist with the commissioning of fuel systems and associated ancillary equipment.
  • The Electrician will carry out fault finding, diagnostics and system verification.
  • Testing and commissioning control systems.
  • Working with low voltage electrical installations.
  • Assisting with PLC commissioning and basic programming modifications.
  • Reading and interpreting electrical drawings and control schematics.
  • Providing post-commissioning technical support and troubleshooting.
  • Completing commissioning documentation and compliance records.
  • Travelling to customer sites across the Sydney metropolitan area.
About You To be successful in this role, you will have:
  • NSW Electrical Trade Qualification and current Electrical Licence (or relevant Engineering Degree with applicable experience).
  • Proven experience in testing and commissioning industrial electrical systems.
  • Experience commissioning control systems and ancillary equipment.
  • Sound knowledge of low voltage electrical systems.
  • Experience with PLCs, including basic programming and fault finding.
  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
  • Ability to interpret electrical schematics and technical documentation.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence.
  • Ability to travel to various sites throughout Sydney.
What's on Offer
  • $60–$65 per hour, depending on experience.
  • Permanent full-time position.
  • Diverse and technically challenging work.
  • Opportunity to work on major fuel infrastructure projects.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Supportive and experienced team environment.
  • Long-term career progression with a growing business.

job.title: Estimator
job.description:
Join a Canberra construction business

An established and growing construction business is looking for an experienced Estimator to join its Canberra team.

This is an opportunity to step into a key role within a collaborative team, working across a diverse range of projects and playing an important part in securing and delivering future work.

The Role
As an Estimator, you will be responsible for preparing accurate and competitive tenders across a range of commercial construction projects. You’ll work closely with the pre-construction and delivery teams, subcontractors and suppliers to ensure projects are priced accurately and strategically.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Preparing detailed and accurate cost estimates and tenders
  • Reviewing plans, specifications, scopes and contract documentation
  • Preparing subcontractor and supplier packages and managing the tender process
  • Obtaining and analysing subcontractor and supplier quotations
  • Identifying project risks, exclusions, variations and opportunities
  • Developing accurate construction methodologies and preliminary costs
  • Preparing tender submissions and supporting documentation
  • Liaising with clients, consultants, subcontractors and suppliers
  • Working closely with Project Managers and the wider construction team
  • Maintaining strong relationships with subcontractors and suppliers across the ACT market
About You
We’re looking for an Estimator who combines strong technical estimating skills with a commercial mindset and a good understanding of the Canberra construction market.

You will ideally have:
  • Previous experience as an Estimator within the commercial construction industry
  • Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, materials and processes
  • The ability to interpret architectural, structural and services drawings
  • Experience preparing tenders from initial review through to submission
  • Strong subcontractor and supplier relationships

job.title: Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Maintenance Technician — Sterile Injectables

Location: Chatswood, NSW
Industry: Pharmaceutical Manufacturing (Sterile Injectables)
Hours: Monday–Friday, 8am–4pm (training period), transitioning to rotating 8am–4pm / 7am–3pm shifts
Salary: $100,000–$115,000 + phone + discretionary bonus

 About the Company

Our client is an Australian-owned pharmaceutical manufacturer supplying hospitals nationally and exporting to international markets, with active plans for further global expansion. While smaller than the multinational giants, the business offers genuine access to senior leadership — including regular contact with the CEO — and continued investment in new machinery and cleanroom infrastructure.

This is a business with a strong retention track record: the maintenance team has very low turnover, with tenures ranging from 3 to 20+ years. You'll be joining a close-knit, growing team of 4.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on Maintenance Technician to join the site's maintenance team, working across cleanroom and aseptic suite environments supporting liquid filling and sterile injectable manufacturing. This is a step up for someone with tablet/solid-dose maintenance experience looking to move into liquid/sterile processing — or a great fit for someone already working in sterile injectables.

You'll partner closely with a senior technician during onboarding before moving onto the standard rotating roster.

Reporting to: Asset Manager (who reports to the Chief Operations Manager, then CEO)

Key Responsibilities

- Perform preventative maintenance on equipment, critical systems, and services — including purified water systems, cleanroom/aseptic suite systems, vision systems, blister and packaging equipment, and vial-based theatre pack lines (vials sterilised for direct use in operating theatres)
- Attend to breakdowns and troubleshoot faults across equipment, critical systems, and services, escalating to external contractors when a fault is beyond in-house scope
- Investigate and report breakdown root causes and concerns to management
- Ensure adherence to the preventative maintenance schedule
- Document all work and maintain accurate records in the CMMS within a cGMP-compliant change control environment
- Coordinate maintenance and repair activities with external service providers as required

What You'll Also Do

- Follow standard operating procedures in all work performed
- Complete GMP-standard documentation for work activities
- Contribute to the development of procedures and related documentation
- Support investigations into incidents, accidents, quality, and governance issues as needed
- Work collaboratively across Production, R&D, NPI, Validation, and QA/QC to support business objectives
- Identify, assess, and control workplace hazards and risks
- Report any accidents or incidents on the day they occur

 About You

- Mechanically minded, with proven maintenance technician experience in a regulated pharmaceutical environment
- Liquid filling / sterile injectable manufacturing experience strongly preferred; solid dose (tablet) experience will also be considered
- Food manufacturing background is not a fit for this role
- Working knowledge of CMMS platforms
- Exposure to equipment commissioning and validation processes
- Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding skills across mechanical, electrical, or utilities systems (purified water systems, vision systems, packaging lines)
- Comfortable working to GMP/cGMP standards and change control processes
- A collaborative approach and willingness to train and support colleagues
- Strong commitment to workplace health and safety
- No formal pharma qualification required — full training and support provided; the business will also consider candidates straight out of a mechanical apprenticeship


 Why Apply

- Direct, regular exposure to senior leadership including the CEO — a level of access not typical at larger multinational manufacturers
- Genuinely low staff turnover and a stable, tenured team culture
- Ongoing investment in new equipment and cleanroom upgrades
- Structured onboarding alongside a senior technician
- Company-supported training courses (up to $2,000) and career development, including pathways for apprentice-level candidates
- A growing, internationally expanding business with export markets beyond Australia

Interested in learning more? Apply now or reach out for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Structural Engineer
job.description:
Structural Engineer

Looking for a Civil/Structural Engineer for a well-established, niche Consulting Engineering and Building Design firm based in Southern Sydney, with a strong focus on structural engineering.

Our work is predominantly centred around the assessment, investigation and design of existing residential structures, including buildings impacted by fire, tree and vehicle damage, as well as structural defects and remedial works.

We are seeking a motivated and detail-driven Civil/Structural Engineer to join our growing team. This is a great opportunity for an engineer who enjoys structural engineering, wants strong technical exposure and is keen to develop their career alongside experienced senior engineers.

The role is highly structures-focused, with exposure to structural assessment, site investigations, causation reporting, remedial design and structural design across timber, steel and concrete.

Key Responsibilities
  • Undertake structural inspections and assessments of existing buildings.
  • Investigate structural defects, damage and failures and determine causation.
  • Prepare detailed technical and causation reports.
  • Develop scopes of structural and remedial works.
  • Undertake structural analysis and design across timber, steel and concrete.
  • Prepare structural drawings and documentation using AutoCAD.
  • Liaise with clients, contractors and other stakeholders.
  • Work closely with senior engineers and contribute to project delivery.
Skills & Experience
  • Civil or Structural Engineering degree.
  • Experience in structural consulting or building design is desirable.
  • Strong understanding of structural behaviour and engineering fundamentals.
  • Developing or demonstrated capability in timber, steel and concrete design.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent technical report writing and written English.
  • High attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD.
  • Strong communication skills and a willingness to attend site.
  • Genuine interest in developing a career in structural engineering.
Why Join us?
  • Structures-heavy workload with genuine technical exposure.
  • Work across investigation, assessment, remedial and new structural design.
  • Mentoring from experienced senior engineers.
  • 30-week Engineering Seminar Program.
  • Exposure to a broad range of structures across NSW and ACT.
  • Competitive remuneration and performance-based bonuses.
  • Company vehicle provided as part of the remuneration package.
  • Long-term career opportunity within a growing specialist consultancy

job.title: Senior Interior Designer - Workplace
job.description:
Melbourne | Permanent | Senior-Level Opportunities

We are currently working with two highly regarded Melbourne interior design studios that are looking to appoint experienced Senior Interior Designers to their workplace teams.
While both opportunities sit within the workplace sector, they offer very different environments and project types. Both roles require strong design capability, project leadership and advanced Revit documentation skills.
 
ROLE 1 – Senior Interior Designer | Workplace D&C / Spec Suites Fast-paced workplace design | Design & Documentation | D&C Environment
This is an exciting opportunity to join a design-led business delivering high-volume workplace projects, spec suites and commercial office fit-outs.
The role will suit a Senior Interior Designer who enjoys working at pace, taking ownership of projects and moving seamlessly between concept design, design development and detailed Revit documentation.

The Role
You will be responsible for running multiple workplace projects from design through to delivery, working closely with clients, consultants, builders and internal teams.

You will be involved in:
  • Leading workplace projects from concept through to documentation and delivery
  • Developing workplace concepts, layouts, test fits and design solutions
  • Producing detailed Revit documentation and construction packages
  • Working within a D&C-style environment, responding quickly to project requirements and construction constraints
  • Managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
  • Coordinating consultants and external stakeholders
  • Working directly with clients to understand requirements and develop design solutions
  • Reviewing and resolving documentation, design and construction issues
  • Attending site meetings and supporting projects through delivery
  • Selecting finishes, materials, furniture and fixtures
  • Working closely with project managers, builders and contractors
  • Maintaining a high standard of design quality while working within tight programmes
About You We are looking for someone who is:
  • An experienced Senior Interior Designer with strong workplace experience
  • Highly proficient in Revit with the ability to independently produce detailed documentation
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced D&C or delivery-focused environment
  • Experienced running projects rather than purely contributing to design
  • Confident managing clients, consultants and contractors
  • Commercially aware and comfortable making practical design decisions
  • Organised, proactive and able to manage multiple deadlines
  • Someone who enjoys being hands-on with both design and documentation
This role would particularly suit someone who enjoys the combination of creative design + technical delivery and wants to work in an environment where projects move quickly.
 
ROLE 2 – Senior Interior Designer | Premium Workplace & Wellness Design-led studio | Workplace & Wellness | Team Leadership | High-End Projects

The second opportunity is with a high-end, design-focused interior studio delivering premium workplace, wellness and commercial interiors.
This is a more design-led environment, suited to a Senior Interior Designer who wants to take ownership of projects, lead teams and contribute to the creative direction of significant workplace projects.

The Role
You will take responsibility for projects across the full design lifecycle, from early concept through to detailed documentation and delivery.
You will be involved in:
  • Leading workplace and wellness projects from concept through to completion
  • Developing strong design concepts and design narratives
  • Leading and mentoring junior and mid-level designers
  • Managing project teams and coordinating workloads
  • Preparing presentations and presenting design concepts to clients
  • Developing detailed design and documentation packages
  • Producing and reviewing Revit documentation
  • Coordinating consultants and project stakeholders
  • Managing project programmes, deliverables and deadlines
  • Working closely with clients to understand their vision and requirements
  • Material, finishes, furniture and FF&E selection
  • Supporting project delivery and construction coordination
  • Maintaining design quality and consistency throughout the project
  • Contributing to the studio's broader design culture and creative direction
About You You will ideally have:
  • Strong experience within workplace interior design
  • Proven experience running projects independently
  • Strong conceptual and design development skills
  • Advanced Revit documentation capability
  • Experience leading or mentoring designers
  • Excellent client-facing and presentation skills
  • Strong understanding of workplace design principles
  • Experience coordinating consultants and contractors
  • A high level of attention to detail
  • A genuine passion for high-quality interior design
You don't need to be a traditional "Design Director" to be successful here. The studio is looking for someone who is hands-on, design-focused and capable of taking ownership of projects and people.
 
Which opportunity is right for you? What both opportunities offer Both studios offer the opportunity to work on high-quality Melbourne workplace projects, take genuine ownership of projects and have a significant impact on the finished product.

If you're a Senior Interior Designer who is looking for more responsibility, stronger project ownership and the opportunity to work across design, leadership and Revit documentation, we'd love to hear from you.

An established international property developer is expanding its presence in the Australian market and is looking to appoint an experienced Development Manager to help drive its high-rise residential pipeline across Sydney.

With a strong track record delivering large-scale residential developments internationally and a growing presence in Australia, the business is now focused on securing and developing major high-rise opportunities across NSW.

This is a senior development role suited to an experienced Development Manager with a strong track record across high-rise residential projects, who can work closely with the investment and strategy teams to assess and secure new opportunities before leading them through the development lifecycle.

The Role:

Reporting to the CEO and working closely with the investment, strategy and construction teams, you will be responsible for:
  • Identifying and assessing high-rise residential development opportunities across Sydney.
  • Working with investment and strategy teams to assess and secure new projects.
  • Leading projects through development, planning and approval phases.
  • Managing project strategy, programmes, budgets, consultants and key stakeholders.
  • Leading developments through to handover to the construction and project delivery teams.
About You:
  • Significant Development Management experience within the Sydney construction market.
  • Strong track record across high-rise residential / apartment developments.
  • Experience across front-end development and the assessment and acquisition of new opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of NSW planning, approvals and the broader development process.
  • Commercially astute with strong stakeholder management and Sydney market knowledge.
The Opportunity:
  • Established international developer expanding across Australia
  • Key role growing the NSW high-rise residential portfolio
  • Major development opportunities across Sydney
  • Work closely with senior leadership and investment teams
  • Competitive package with flexibility for the right person
For any questions relating to this role or other opportunities with D&B and our clients, please contact Adam Shaw on 02 9376 8200 or click apply. Your application will be treated as strictly confidential.

job.title: Contract Administrator - Multi-Storey Commercial Construction Melbourne West
job.description:
Truganina | Permanent
The Opportunity
A growing Melbourne-based commercial and industrial builder is looking to appoint two Contract Administrators to support the delivery of new multi-storey projects in Melbourne's western suburbs, with the immediate focus being Truganina.

The business has recently secured a five-storey mixed-use development as part of a broader five-building masterplan. There is also potential for an additional adjacent project of a similar scope.

This represents an exciting period of growth for the business as it continues to expand its capabilities beyond its traditional industrial portfolio and into more complex multi-storey commercial and mixed-use construction.

About the Business
The company is an established Victorian construction and development business with a strong track record across:
  • Industrial and logistics
  • Warehousing and distribution
  • Commercial
  • Office
  • Retail
  • Hospitality
  • Mixed-use developments
They have built their reputation around quality construction, strong client relationships and a hands-on approach to project delivery.
The business has a collaborative and practical culture, with a strong emphasis on teamwork, accountability and delivering quality outcomes rather than operating within a heavily corporate environment.

Why This Role Is Different
The business has traditionally delivered a significant volume of industrial construction, where projects can be relatively straightforward from a commercial and contractual perspective.

The new multi-storey projects introduce a different level of complexity, including:
  • Multiple levels and building interfaces
  • Greater design development
  • Increased consultant coordination
  • More complex subcontractor packages
  • Significant variation and change management
  • More involved services coordination
  • Greater client and consultant interaction
  • Design changes throughout construction
  • Increased commercial and programme implications
As a result, they are specifically looking for CAs who understand how to manage the commercial consequences of change, rather than simply administering straightforward subcontract packages.

The Role
Working closely with the Project Manager and site team, you will take responsibility for the commercial and contractual administration of your project.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing subcontractor packages from procurement through to completion
  • Preparing and administering subcontracts and purchase orders
  • Reviewing subcontractor scopes and quotations
  • Managing progress claims and payment schedules
  • Assessing, negotiating and administering variations
  • Managing EOTs and contractual notices
  • Identifying the commercial impact of design and scope changes
  • Maintaining accurate cost reporting and forecasting
  • Managing RFIs and coordinating with consultants and subcontractors
  • Reviewing drawings, specifications and design changes
  • Supporting procurement and subcontractor negotiations
  • Maintaining project registers and commercial documentation
  • Working closely with the PM to maintain project budgets and programme
  • Supporting the project through to final account and handover
What We're Looking For The ideal candidate will have:
  • 4+ years' experience as a Contract Administrator
  • Strong commercial construction experience
  • Experience across multi-storey commercial, residential or mixed-use projects
  • Strong understanding of variations, EOTs, progress claims and subcontract administration
  • Experience managing design and scope changes
  • Strong procurement and subcontractor management skills
  • Ability to read and interpret drawings and specifications
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong commercial awareness and attention to detail
  • A proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues
If you're a CA looking to broaden your experience into more complex multi-storey construction and want to join a growing builder where you can have genuine ownership of your projects, this could be an excellent next step

This is a large-scale project involving the construction of a new floor above the existing centre, alongside extensive retail store refurbishments and mechanical services upgrades. The role will suit a Site Manager who is technically strong, highly organised and confident coordinating HVAC works alongside multiple other trades and services.

The Opportunity

  • Major shopping centre refurbishment project with a long project pipeline
  • Opportunity to work on technically complex HVAC upgrade and refurbishment works
  • Stable position with an established and well-respected HVAC contractor
  • High level of autonomy across site delivery, coordination and day-to-day management
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage the day-to-day delivery of HVAC works, ensuring works are completed safely, efficiently and to programme.
  • Coordinate HVAC works with electrical, fire, hydraulic, structural and other building services trades to minimise clashes and maintain project progress.
  • Read, interpret and coordinate mechanical drawings, specifications and documentation, identifying issues and communicating requirements to relevant stakeholders.
  • Manage site logistics including deliveries, materials, access, labour requirements, subcontractors and daily work sequencing.
  • Oversee SWMS, QA, site inspections, documentation and compliance while maintaining high standards of workmanship and safety.
About You
  • Proven experience as an HVAC Site Manager, Site Supervisor or similar role within commercial HVAC construction or refurbishment.
  • Strong understanding of commercial HVAC systems, including car park exhaust, smoke exhaust, dedicated plant and rooftop packaged units.
  • Ability to confidently read and interpret mechanical drawings and coordinate HVAC works with other building services.
  • Strong organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage subcontractors, deliveries, site activities and competing priorities.
  • Trade-qualified HVAC/Refrigeration background preferred, with solid experience delivering complex commercial projects.
If you're an experienced HVAC Site Manager looking for a major refurbishment project where your technical and coordination skills will be valued, apply now or email your CV to louis@designandbuild.com.au for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Drafting Manager
job.description:
Drafting Manager - Mechanical Services
Dandenong South | $150k - $165k + Super + Vehicle
 
The Company
Our client is a well-established Tier 2 Mechanical Contractor delivering HVAC and mechanical services across a range of major commercial, industrial and infrastructure projects throughout Victoria.
Due to continued growth and an increasing project pipeline, they are looking to appoint an experienced Drafting Manager to take ownership of their drafting function and lead a team of mechanical drafters.
This is a great opportunity to join a growing contractor where you will have genuine influence over processes, systems and the development of the drafting team.
The Role
Reporting into the senior management team, you will be responsible for managing the company's drafting function and ensuring projects are delivered with accurate, coordinated and high-quality mechanical documentation.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing and mentoring a team of mechanical drafters.
  • Overseeing drafting deliverables across multiple projects.
  • Producing and reviewing detailed HVAC and mechanical services drawings.
  • Managing drawing standards, revisions and document control.
  • Coordinating mechanical services with architectural, structural, electrical and other building services.
  • Working closely with Project Managers, Engineers and Site Teams.
  • Assisting with design coordination and resolving construction-related drafting issues.
  • Managing project priorities, deadlines and drafting resources.
  • Reviewing drawings for accuracy, constructability and quality.
  • Supporting BIM/Revit coordination and clash detection.
  • Developing and improving drafting processes, standards and systems.
  • Liaising with consultants, builders and subcontractors where required.
  • Providing technical guidance and support to the wider project team.
About You
To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
  • Previous experience within mechanical services / HVAC drafting.
  • Experience managing or leading a drafting team.
  • Strong AutoCAD and/or Revit MEP skills.
  • A strong understanding of HVAC systems and mechanical services construction.
  • Previous experience working for a mechanical contractor or building services contractor.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • A practical understanding of how mechanical services are delivered on-site.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem solving.
Experience across commercial, industrial, healthcare, data centre or major infrastructure projects will be highly regarded.
 
What's on Offer?
  • $150k - $165k + Super + Vehicle
  • Opportunity to lead and develop an established drafting team.
  • Join a growing Tier 2 mechanical contractor.
  • Genuine opportunity to influence systems and processes.
  • Exposure to major mechanical services projects.
  • Strong pipeline of work.
  • Supportive senior management team.
  • Long-term career progression.
If you're an experienced Mechanical Drafter, Senior Drafter, BIM Coordinator or Drafting Manager looking for the next step in your career, we'd be keen to hear from you.
 
Apply now or contact Connor at Design & Build Recruitment for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
An established and growing civil infrastructure contractor is looking to appoint an experienced Project Manager to join its Sydney operations.

This is a key appointment within the project team, offering the opportunity to take ownership of a significant transport infrastructure package and play a major role in its successful delivery. The successful candidate will work closely with senior leadership and a broad project team, while developing strong relationships with the client, consultants and delivery partners.

About the Role
As Project Manager, you will have overall responsibility for coordinating and driving project delivery, ensuring key milestones, financial targets, contractual requirements and safety objectives are achieved.

You will work across all stages of the project, from planning and procurement through to construction and completion. The role will suit a commercially minded Project Manager who is comfortable operating in a complex civil environment and enjoys taking ownership of project outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
  • Take overall responsibility for project delivery, performance and outcomes.
  • Establish and maintain project plans, program, budgets and reporting systems.
  • Coordinate engineering, construction, commercial, procurement and site activities.
  • Work collaboratively with the Construction Manager to maintain program and productivity.
  • Manage project costs, cash flow, forecasting and financial performance.
  • Lead subcontractor procurement, negotiations and performance management.
  • Identify commercial risks, project constraints and opportunities at an early stage.
  • Manage variations, claims, contractual matters and client reporting.
  • Maintain productive relationships with government clients, consultants and key stakeholders.
  • Ensure project activities meet relevant safety, environmental, quality and contractual requirements.
  • Provide leadership and support to Project Engineers, Site Engineers and other project team members.
  • Contribute to project strategy and continuous improvement across the wider business.
What You'll Bring
  • Degree qualification in Civil Engineering or a similar discipline.
  • Strong experience delivering civil infrastructure projects for a principal contractor.
  • Demonstrated Project Management experience on projects in the $75M–$100M range.
  • Background in roads, transport infrastructure or other major civil works.
  • Experience working with Transport for NSW or similar government clients.
  • Knowledge of GC21 and other government contracting frameworks would be advantageous.
  • Strong commercial capability, including forecasting, cost control, variations and claims.
  • Proven ability to manage subcontractors and coordinate multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong understanding of project programming, planning and construction methodologies.
  • Confident communicator with the ability to build relationships at all levels.
  • Knowledge of the Sydney civil construction market and established industry relationships would be highly regarded.
If this challenge interests you and your experience matches closely, then please apply and we will be in touch to discuss further.
