job.title: HSEQ Officer
job.description:
We're currently looking for an experienced HSEQ Officer to join a well-established and growing organisation operating across a diverse range of industries including construction, infrastructure, mining, utilities and property development.

This role will see you supporting the business across health, safety, quality and environmental functions, working closely with operational leaders and employees to maintain compliance, strengthen systems and continue driving a positive HSEQ culture.

We're looking for someone who is proactive, hands-on and confident building relationships across all levels of an organisation. This position would suit an HSQE professional who enjoys a balance of operational support, compliance, auditing and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
  • Providing day-to-day HSQE support across the business
  • Supporting the maintenance and continual improvement of the Integrated Management System (IMS)
  • Assisting with ISO-certified systems and certification audits
  • Monitoring compliance with WHS, environmental and quality legislation and client requirements
  • Conducting workplace inspections, audits and site engagements
  • Supporting risk assessments, risk registers and psychosocial hazard management
  • Managing incident reporting, investigations, corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Supporting Respect@Work and workplace behaviour initiatives
  • Developing, reviewing and maintaining HSQE policies, procedures and management plans
  • Monitoring HSQE performance and preparing reports and performance metrics
  • Supporting toolbox talks, HSQE meetings and safety communications
  • Assisting with project onboarding, client prequalification and contractor compliance
  • Providing practical HSQE advice to operational leaders and employees
  • Keeping up to date with legislative changes and industry developments
About You
  • Previous experience as an HSQE Officer, HSQE Advisor, Safety Advisor or similar
  • Relevant qualifications in Work Health & Safety, Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Management, Quality Management or a related discipline
  • Strong understanding of Australian WHS legislation and regulatory requirements
  • Experience supporting Integrated Management Systems and ISO certifications
  • Experience conducting audits, inspections, risk assessments and incident investigations
  • Experience with psychosocial hazard management and workplace behaviour initiatives
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
  • Strong Microsoft 365 and SharePoint skills
  • Construction White Card
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence
  • Full Australian working rights
Experience within construction, surveying, engineering, infrastructure, mining or other multi-site environments will be highly regarded.
What We Offer
  • Opportunity to join a well-established and growing organisation
  • Strong and established HSQE culture
  • Diverse projects across multiple industries
  • Opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and operational teams
  • Flexible working options
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment
  • Employee assistance program
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid community service leave

job.title: BIM / Archicad Trainer
job.description:
Design & Build are partnering with a leading Australian residential building organisation to recruit a BIM / Archicad Trainer to join their People Development function.

Based in the Hunter Region, this role will support drafting teams nationally and will involve regular travel, both interstate and nationally.

Importantly, you don't need to already be an experienced trainer.

We're equally interested in hearing from experienced Archicad 29 users, Senior Drafters, BIM specialists or technical drafting professionals who enjoy helping others and would like to pivot their career into training and development.

For the right technical person, the business is prepared to invest in your development and support you in completing your Certificate IV in Training & Assessment.

The Role
Working closely with the BIM Manager and Learning & Development team, you'll become a key technical resource supporting drafting teams across the organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Delivering Archicad and BIM training to drafting teams across Australia
  • Supporting the onboarding and technical induction of new starters
  • Developing structured Archicad training programs
  • Creating training materials including guides, videos, e-learning content, job aids and SOPs
  • Running face-to-face and virtual training sessions
  • Working one-on-one and with small groups to improve technical capability
  • Identifying knowledge gaps and opportunities to improve BIM processes and training
  • Working with internal technical specialists and external BIM providers
  • Monitoring training participation and effectiveness
  • Travelling nationally to support teams across different locations
About You
There are two backgrounds we're particularly interested in:

Experienced Trainer: You may already be delivering BIM, Archicad, CAD or technical training and be looking for an opportunity within a large national organisation.

Experienced Archicad User Ready for a Career Pivot: You may be a Senior Drafter, BIM Coordinator, Archicad specialist or highly experienced residential drafting professional who loves helping others and wants to move away from day-to-day drafting into a training-focused career.
Ideally, you'll bring:
  • Strong Archicad experience – Archicad 29 highly regarded
  • A background in drafting, BIM or residential construction
  • Confidence communicating technical information in a simple way
  • Strong interpersonal and presentation skills
  • An interest in coaching, mentoring and developing others
  • The ability and willingness to travel nationally
  • A proactive approach to technology and continuous improvement
  • A current driver's licence
A Certificate IV in Training & Assessment is advantageous but not essential – support can be provided to obtain this qualification for the right candidate.

Why Consider This Opportunity?
This is a unique opportunity to take your technical Archicad knowledge and turn it into a long-term career in training and capability development.
You'll join a major Australian building organisation, work closely with BIM and L&D specialists, gain exposure to drafting teams nationally and have the opportunity to become a recognised technical training specialist within the business.
If you're an Archicad expert who's always the person others come to for help, this could be the career pivot you've been looking for.

Apply now or contact Renee Hamilton at Design & Build Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

  • Develop effective tender strategies through detailed project and client due diligence
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients
  • Drive business development activities aligned with company growth objectives

About You:

  • A collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively within a high performing team

job.title: MEP BIM Modeler
job.description:
BIM Modeler - Tier 1 MEP Contractor
Location: Melbourne, VIC
Salary: $110,000 - $125,000 + Super
Employment Type: Full-time
Sector: MEP / Building Services / Data Centres
 
The Opportunity
We are currently working with a leading Tier 1 MEP contractor delivering major mechanical and electrical projects across Melbourne, including complex commercial, industrial and data centre developments.
Due to continued project growth, they are looking for an experienced BIM Modeler to join their project delivery team. This is an excellent opportunity to work on technically complex projects alongside experienced engineers, project managers and construction teams.
 
The Role
As a BIM Modeler, you will be responsible for developing, coordinating and maintaining high-quality BIM models throughout the project lifecycle.
You will work closely with engineering, design, project management and site teams to ensure models accurately reflect project requirements and are suitable for construction and installation.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and maintain detailed MEP BIM models using Revit and associated modelling software.
  • Produce coordinated models and drawings for mechanical and/or electrical building services.
  • Work closely with engineers, project managers, subcontractors and site teams to resolve design and coordination issues.
  • Participate in BIM coordination and clash detection processes.
  • Review design information and identify potential constructability issues.
  • Assist with the preparation of shop drawings, fabrication information and construction documentation.
  • Maintain model accuracy and ensure deliverables meet project BIM standards and requirements.
  • Coordinate with architectural, structural and other services models.
  • Support project teams throughout design, construction and commissioning phases.
  • Contribute to BIM standards, processes and continuous improvement.
  • Attend coordination meetings and communicate modelling/design issues effectively.
About You
The successful candidate will ideally have:
  • Previous experience as a BIM Modeler within an MEP, mechanical, electrical or building services environment.
  • Strong proficiency in Revit.
  • Experience with Navisworks and clash detection/coordination.
  • Good understanding of mechanical and/or electrical building services.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation.
  • Experience working within a contractor, subcontractor or construction environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and an understanding of constructability.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fast-paced project environment.
Desirable Experience
Experience across any of the following would be highly regarded:
  • Data Centres / Mission Critical
  • Commercial construction
  • Industrial projects
  • High-rise developments
  • Large-scale infrastructure
  • Mechanical services
  • Electrical services
  • Fabrication modelling
  • Revit MEP
  • Navisworks Manage
Why Join?
  • Join an established Tier 1 MEP contractor.
  • Work on major, technically complex projects.
  • Exposure to some of Melbourne's largest construction and data centre developments.
  • Strong career progression into BIM Coordinator / BIM Manager positions.
  • Work alongside experienced engineering and project delivery teams.
  • Competitive salary of $110,000 - $125,000 + Super, depending on experience.
Apply
If you're an experienced BIM Modeler looking to take the next step with a leading MEP contractor, we'd like to hear from you.
Apply now or contact us for a confidential discussion about the opportunity.

job.title: Senior Electrical Project Engineer
job.description:
Senior Electrical Engineer - Tier 1 MEP Contractor
Location: Melbourne, VIC
Salary: $155,000 - $180,000 + Super
Employment Type: Full-time
Sector: MEP / Building Services / Data Centres
 
The Opportunity
We are representing a leading Tier 1 MEP contractor delivering major mechanical and electrical projects across Melbourne.
Due to continued growth and a strong project pipeline, they are looking to appoint an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to join their project delivery team.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced electrical engineer to work on technically complex projects, taking ownership of electrical packages while working closely with project managers, construction teams, consultants and subcontractors.
The Role
As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you will play a key role in the technical delivery of major MEP projects, ensuring electrical works are coordinated, technically compliant and delivered to the required quality, programme and commercial standards.
You will be involved throughout the project lifecycle, from design coordination and procurement through to installation, testing and commissioning.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage the technical delivery of electrical packages across major construction projects.
  • Review electrical designs, specifications, drawings and technical documentation.
  • Coordinate electrical services with mechanical, architectural, structural and other disciplines.
  • Work closely with consultants, subcontractors, suppliers and internal project teams.
  • Identify and resolve technical, design and constructability issues.
  • Review shop drawings, technical submissions, RFIs and design changes.
  • Support procurement and subcontractor management for electrical packages.
  • Monitor installation against approved designs, specifications and project requirements.
  • Assist with project programming, sequencing and technical planning.
  • Support testing, commissioning and handover activities.
  • Ensure works comply with relevant Australian Standards, codes and project specifications.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers and project team members.
  • Attend design, coordination, construction and client meetings.
  • Assist the Project Manager and wider project team with technical and commercial decision-making.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure engineering deliverables are completed on schedule.
About You
The successful candidate will ideally have:
  • A Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
  • Strong experience working within MEP, building services or construction environments.
  • Proven experience delivering electrical packages on medium to large-scale projects.
  • Strong understanding of electrical building services and construction methodologies.
  • Excellent knowledge of electrical design, coordination and installation.
  • Experience working with consultants, subcontractors and Tier 1 contractors.
  • Strong understanding of Australian Standards and relevant electrical codes.
  • Excellent communication, coordination and stakeholder management skills.
  • The ability to work autonomously while contributing effectively to a wider project team.
  • Strong commercial and problem-solving awareness.
Desirable Experience
Experience across any of the following would be highly regarded:
  • Data Centres / Mission Critical
  • Commercial construction
  • Industrial projects
  • High-rise developments
  • Healthcare
  • Infrastructure
  • Critical power systems
  • HV/LV electrical systems
  • UPS and generator systems
  • Switchboards and distribution systems
  • Electrical testing and commissioning
  • Revit / BIM coordination
  • Tier 1 MEP contractor experience
What You'll Receive
  • $155,000 - $180,000 + Super, depending on experience.
  • Opportunity to join a leading Tier 1 MEP contractor.
  • Exposure to major Melbourne projects and technically complex environments.
  • Significant exposure to data centre and mission-critical projects.
  • Clear progression into Lead Engineer, Project Manager and Engineering Management positions.
  • Work alongside highly experienced project delivery and engineering teams.
  • Long-term career stability with a strong project pipeline.
Apply
If you're an experienced Electrical Engineer looking to step into a senior position with a leading Tier 1 MEP contractor, we'd like to hear from you.
Apply now or contact us for a confidential discussion about the opportunity.

job.title: Accounts Payable - Construction & Manufacturing Industry
job.description:
Accounts Payable Officer | Construction | North Sydney

Are you an experienced Accounts Payable professional looking to join a well-established construction and manufacturing business where you'll be more than just a number?

We're working with a respected contractor delivering commercial and infrastructure projects across NSW. Due to continued growth, they're seeking an experienced Accounts Payable Officer to join their finance team and take ownership of the end-to-end AP function.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced project environment and enjoys building relationships with suppliers, Project Managers and internal stakeholders.

The Role:

Reporting to the Finance Manager, you'll be responsible for the timely and accurate processing of supplier invoices while supporting the wider finance team across multiple live projects.

Key responsibilities include:
  • End-to-end Accounts Payable processing across multiple projects.
  • High-volume invoice processing, coding and data entry.
  • Three-way matching of purchase orders, invoices and delivery dockets.
  • Supplier statement reconciliations and payment runs.
  • Liaising with Project Managers and Site Teams to resolve invoice queries.
  • Managing subcontractor invoices and ensuring compliance documentation is received.
  • Processing employee expense claims and company credit card reconciliations.
  • Maintaining supplier accounts and setting up new vendors.
  • Assisting with month-end close, accruals and reporting.
  • Supporting continuous improvement of AP processes and systems.
About You:
  • Previous Accounts Payable experience within the construction, engineering, property or infrastructure industry.
  • Strong understanding of project-based invoicing and purchase order processes.
  • Experience working with high-volume invoices and multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent reconciliation skills and high attention to detail.
  • The ability to prioritise workload and meet strict payment deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills and a proactive, team-focused attitude.
  • Experience using ERP systems such as Jobpac, CHEOPS, Viewpoint, Pronto, MYOB, SAP, Oracle, TechnologyOne, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite or similar will be highly regarded.
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills.
What's on Offer
  • Join a reputable and growing construction business with a strong pipeline of work.
  • Supportive and collaborative finance team.
  • Exposure to large-scale commercial projects.
  • Long-term career progression opportunities.
  • Stable, permanent position with a competitive salary package.
  • Modern office environment and a positive team culture.
If you're an experienced Accounts Payable professional looking to further your career within the construction industry, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: DIDO Civil Supervisor - 10:4 or 2:1

Leaders are trusted to run their projects properly, supported by capable crews, clear systems and a stable pipeline of work. It is an environment suited to experienced Project Managers and Supervisors who value accountability, teamwork and delivering quality outcomes on site.

This is a practical on site role where you will oversee crews, plant and subcontractors to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently and to a high standard.
  
The role operates on a 10:4 or 2:1 roster with accommodation and meal allowance provided.

  • Hands on experience supervising road construction projects
  • Skilled at managing crews, plant and subcontractors on sit
  • Able to support and guide junior staff in their daily tasks
  • Strong commitment to safety, quality and efficient work practices

  • 4 to 5 years supervising civil infrastructure or road construction projects
  • Proven ability to manage site operations including labour, plant and subcontractors
  • Focused on safe, efficient and high quality project delivery
  • Comfortable working on a 10 days on 4 days off roster in the South West
